I really wanted to like this groomer because they came highly recommended, and I do appreciate how kind the staff was to my dog. While grooming her, they spoke to her in a calm, gentle voice and genuinely tried to help her feel comfortable, and I appreciated seeing that.

Unfortunately, the overall experience was very disappointing.

Our appointment was scheduled for 12:00 p.m., but we didn't leave until around 4:30 p.m. I completely understand that unexpected delays happen, especially if earlier appointments take longer than expected. However, if I have a scheduled appointment, I don't understand why my dog wasn't groomed closer to that appointment time. It seemed like she spent a significant amount of time waiting in a kennel before her groom even started, because there is no way the actual grooming itself took four and a half hours.

The environment was also extremely overstimulating. There were dogs barking nonstop, phones constantly ringing, and even a rooster crowing. On top of that, the building was very warm with no air conditioning that I could tell, and there was a strong odor of dog and cat urine when we walked in. It didn't feel like a calm or relaxing environment, especially for dogs that are nervous or anxious.

As for the haircut itself, it was shorter than I had hoped, but that was explained to me beforehand because my dog had some matting. While it wasn't my preferred length, I understand why it needed to be done and don't have an issue with that.

What upset me most was how stressed my dog was afterward. She was panting heavily when I picked her up, wanted to be left alone when we got home, and was clearly overwhelmed. She normally does much better after grooming appointments, so it was hard to see how anxious and overstimulated she was after spending so many hours there.

The staff was kind, and I truly appreciate the care they showed my dog while working with her. However, the long wait despite having an appointment, combined with the noisy, hot, and overwhelming environment, makes this a place I personally wouldn't return to.
